The fish can swim! Swish, swish!

youtube.title: Mittens' Animal Moves! (ACHOO!) | Nerdy Noodles
youtube.description:
🐸 ACHOO! Mittens the cat sneezed so big that all the animal friends ran away! Can you help Mittens find them?

Learn how animals move with Mittens: the frog hops in the pond, the fish swims in the ocean, the bird flies in the sky, and the horse gallops and the duck waddles on the farm, and the dog wags its tail in the park. Hear the REAL sound each animal makes, then sing the animal moves song with Mittens. Stay till the end, because one more friend has a very big move! 🐾

Perfect for toddlers, preschoolers and kindergarten kids (ages 2-6).

✨ In this video, kids will:
✔️ Learn action words: hop, swim, fly, gallop, waddle and wag
✔️ Learn 6 animal names: frog, fish, bird, horse, duck and dog
✔️ Hear the real sounds animals make
✔️ Sing an animal moves song with Mittens!
